corpus.selection: cold launch immediately after backend revision changed; configured profiles preserved

time_basis: seconds after the probe wall-clock start; source logs classified by local wall time; these are observed bounds, not per-phase monotonic spans

conclusions.claim: The native session barrier was observed about 39 seconds before whole-gateway readiness; primary Telegram connection was not the local readiness barrier.
Native readiness still took about a minute of actual owner process age on this revision-change cold launch; the hermetic readiness timings do not establish fast live cold launch.
The native gate still follows primary adapter construction, and optional turn warmup starts before both construction and the native gate.

The post-runner-start delay correlates closely with warmup completion, but existing logs do not separate primary adapter construction, secondary config/plugin preparation, and shared import-lock contention.
Optional MCP network discovery is not established as the dominant remaining delay; its startup budget released about two seconds after the control listener log.

source_evidence.boundary: revision-change guard runs home maintenance once per install/profile/revision
profile authorities and private listeners are initialized before runner startup
warmup scheduling, primary adapter construction, native gate, then primary connects
dependency probe runs off-loop; adapter creation still returns synchronously on the owner loop
secret hydration/migration are off-loop, while scoped plugin discovery/config and ACL validation include synchronous owner-loop work
all-profile preflight and pending-spool recovery precede native publication
MCP module imports occur inside the discovery coroutine before executor dispatch

limits: One revision-change live launch only; no same-revision cold comparison yet.
The shared log format does not carry a process ID; only structured matching lifecycle events were used, correlated with validated owner discovery. Unparsed legacy ready lines were excluded.

The all-profile observation uses sequential probes; one descriptor publishes the staged capability for all served profiles, so the later final observation is not proof of staggered per-profile publication.
Transcript row count is omitted because the original probe read an incorrect response key.

recommended_bounded_followup.action: Repeat one operator-authorized cold launch at the same backend revision after quiescence; preserve configured profiles/tools and confirm revision-change maintenance is skipped.
recommended_bounded_followup.bound: one launch; 150-second observation deadline; no prompt submission

recommended_bounded_followup.action: Add metadata-only monotonic phase spans in an isolated reviewed build for authority initialization, listener binding, MCP imports/budget, warmup, primary construction, secondary plugin/config preflight, spool recovery, native publication and global readiness.
recommended_bounded_followup.bound: stage names, durations and profile counts only; no configuration values, raw names, filesystem locations or conversation data

recommended_bounded_followup.action: Use bounded Python import-duration profiling during that controlled launch and one cheap owner identify probe at a fixed interval to distinguish import-lock stalls from adapter/config work.

recommended_bounded_followup.action: If spans confirm the coupling, evaluate native publication before transport construction and defer optional warmup/SDK import work until after publication while keeping ACL, spool, ownership, fatal and drain guards.
